Name: Imperial
Description: Natives of the civilized, cosmopolitan province of Cyrodiil, they have proved to be shrewd diplomats and traders. They are skilled with heavy armor and in the social skills and tend to favor the warrior classes.
Origins:
Nibenay: You are a true Imperial, born into the heart of the Empire. The number of cities and their size led you to travel hastily.

Colovia: Colovia inhabitants, such as yourself, are known for their autonomy, including toward the rest of the Empire. Your inherited the wilfulness of your forebearers.
